2317-5231-5478-7084.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending Dwarven Mine.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Dwarven Mine.
When Dwarven Mine dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking
When Dwarven Mine enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Dwarf creature token.
Repeat.

643-5330-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
643-5330-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Atog by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Atog ability, giving Atog +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 3.

1874-4499-8160.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Kwia.
When Kwia enters, Ajani's Welcome triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Kwia triggers, creating a Lotus token.
Activate the Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {3}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life

1362-1993-7857.easyPrerequisites: You control eight or fewer lands.
1362-1993-7857.description:
Activate Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life by tapping it, putting Oboro from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Oboro enters the battlefield, Elven Raft-Steerer triggers, untapping Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life.
Activate Oboro's first ability by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Oboro's second ability by paying {1}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
Activate Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life by tapping it, putting Oboro, Palace in the Clouds from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Oboro, Palace in the Clouds enters the battlefield, it and Elven Raft-Steerer trigger.
Resolve the Oboro, Palace in the Clouds trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elven Raft-Steerer trigger, untapping Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life.
Repeat.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

553-819-4668.description:
During the opponent's end step immediately before your turn, cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W} using Heliod, the Warped Eclipse.
In response, cast Memory Lapse by paying its mana cost, putting Approach of the Sun on top of your library.
In your draw step, draw Approach of the Second Sun.
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, winning the game.

2092-3257-4954.notablePrerequisites: Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has at least 7 power.
2092-3257-4954.description:
Activate Rakdos Carnarium by tapping it, adding two mana.
Activate Silvanus's Invoker by paying {1}, untapping Rakdos Carnarium and causing it to become an 8/8 Elemental with trample and haste in addition to its other types until end of turn.
Repeat any number of times.
Once you have infinite mana, you may tap and untap any other land(s) you control, and if you control lands that can produce {R} and {G}, use the mana to activate Agatha of the Vile Cauldron's ability.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

2411-3259-6968.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2411-3259-6968.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Lathril, triggering Breath of Fury and Lathril.
Resolve the Lathril trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

2946-4871-5686-6255.notablePrerequisites:
A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
You have max speed.
2946-4871-5686-6255.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Zahur trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1368-4808-4856.easyPrerequisites:
You've cast a spell this turn.
You have three or more other cards in your graveyard.
1368-4808-4856.description:
Activate Black Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Brain Freeze from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {1}{U} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, ensuring not to exile Black Lotus. Choose to have Brain Freeze target yourself.
Brain Freeze's storm ability triggers, copying it for each spell you've cast before it this turn. Choose to have the first copy target yourself, and all other copies can target any player you desire.
Resolve all Brain Freeze copies, causing you to mill three cards and then the other targeted players to mill cards.
Resolve the original Brain Freeze, causing you to mill three cards.
Cast Black Lotus from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {0} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, ensuring not to exile Brain Freeze.
Repeat.

1368-6321-6791-7763.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-6321-6791-7763.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

5170-6132-6797-7452.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Cauldron of Essence triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Cauldron of Essence trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron of Essence trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

46-223-7411.notablePrerequisites: You have not cast an instant spell this turn.
46-223-7411.description:
Cast Gravitic Punch by paying its mana cost, targeting Kalamax.
Holding priority, cast Cooperate by paying its aftermath cost, targeting Gravitic Punch.
Kalamax's first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the first ability, creating a copy of Cooperate targeting the original Cooperate.
Resolve the second ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Kalamax.
Resolve the Cooperate copy, creating a copy of Cooperate, targeting the original Cooperate.
Kalamax's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Repeat from step 6 any number of times.
Once you have an arbitrarily large Kalamax, have the final Cooperate copy target Gravitic Punch. This'll create two copies of Gravitic Punch in addition to the original Gravitic Punch.
Resolve all Gravitic Punches, dealing infinite damage to each of up to three opponents.

1558-2638-3129-3756-4231.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1558-2638-3129-3756-4231.description:
Play Izzet Boilerworks.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters, it and Tireless Tracker trigger
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Primal Vigor.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

4766-5147-7361.notablePrerequisites: You control five or more Spirits.
4766-5147-7361.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Kodama.
When Kodama dies, its soulshift ability and Deathrender trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting Kodama from your hand onto the battlefield and attaching Deathrender to it.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

141-1638-2060-7267.description:
Cast Quandrix Command by paying its mana cost, choosing its first and third modes.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Quandrix Command, with the copy's first mode targeting Naru Meha and the copy's third mode targeting Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the copy of Quandrix Command, returning Naru Meha from the battlefield to your hand and putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Michelangelo.
Holding priority, activate Crystalline Crawler three times by removing four +1/+1 counters from it, adding {2}{U}{U}.
Repeat from step 2.

3705-4050-5997-7183.description:
Cast Squee from your graveyard or from exile by paying {R}{R}.
Iraxxa triggers, creating a 2/2 Alien Warrior creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Squee and the Alien Warrior, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-3536-5078.description:
Declare Cheering Fanatic as an attacker. When it triggers, choose to name "Sensei's Divining Top".
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Activate Harnfel by discarding a card, exiling the top two cards of your library and allowing you to cast them this turn.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat from step 2

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-5078-6709.easyPrerequisites: Ballad of the Black Flag's fourth chapter ability has triggered this turn
392-5078-6709.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Activate Harnfel by discarding a card, exiling the top two cards of your library and allowing you to cast them this turn.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat.

1251-2440-3581-7109.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
Kykar triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Spirit you control.
Activate Trusty Boomerang's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the Spirit token.
Activate the Spirit token by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature a returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
1251-2440-3581-7109.notes: The cost can be reduced to as little as {1} if you control other Spirits. You can also sacrifice the Spirits once you have enough to get infinite {R}.

3835-5638-7070.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Equipment.
3835-5638-7070.description:
Activate Plate Armor's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting another nontoken creature you control.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending the targeted creature.
The Plate Armor ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast the creature from exile by paying {0} due to Sage of the Beyond.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with a +1/+1 counter on it

1651-4702-4891-5517.description:
Activate Atsushi by tapping it, creating a token copy of it with haste.
Put the Atsushi token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Atsushi token dies, it triggers, creating three Treasure tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two Treasures, untapping Atsushi.
Repeat

2829-3652-4053-6989.description:
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Ornithopter.
Cast Ornithopter from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

1492-2854-4574-5243.easyPrerequisites: Showdown of the Skalds' second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
1492-2854-4574-5243.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.
1492-2854-4574-5243.description:
Cast Welding Jar either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}
Showdown of the Skalds triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Activate Welding Jar by sacrificing it.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Welding Jar from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

339-677-1115-6798.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2743-6785.description:
Cast Devastating Onslaught by paying {6}{R}, creating three token copies of Biovisionary with haste.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers from their own abilities, and each Biovisionary token triggers from the ability given to it from Devastating Onslaught.
Resolve the nontoken Biovisionary's trigger, causing you to win the game.

3525-5268-6210.description:
Activate Neerdiv by tapping it, adding {U}.
Neerdiv triggers, causing a player to mill cards equal to its power.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Neerdiv.
Repeat.

1245-4094.easyPrerequisites:
Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
You control at least two additional creatures
1245-4094.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Tooth and Claw by sacrificing two creatures, creating two 3/1 Carnivore creature tokens.
Repeat step 2.

1003-2232-3661-6134.notablePrerequisites: One of the creatures with mana value 0 must be in your hand with the other on the battlefield.
1003-2232-3661-6134.description:
Cast the creature with mana value 0 from your hand by paying {0}.
Rendmaw triggers, causing each player to create a tapped 2/2 Bird creature token.
When the Bird enters the battlefield under your control, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning a nontoken creature with mana value 0 from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the creature spell cast in step 1.
Repeat.

1750-5141-5261-6211.manaNeeded: {2}{W} the first turn, and {3}{R}{W} each other turn
1750-5141-5261-6211.description:
Cast Teferi's Protection by paying {2}{W}, causing you to gain protection from everything and preventing your life total from changing until your next turn, and phasing all permanents you control out until your next turn, and exiling Teferi's Protection.
During your next turn, activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Pull from Eternity without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Pull from Eternity, putting Teferi's Protection from exile into your graveyard.
At the beginning of your end step, Quintorius triggers, exiling Teferi's Protection from your graveyard and creating a 3/2 Spirit creature token.
Activate Quintorius by paying {1}{R}{W} and sacrificing a Spirit, casting Teferi's Protection from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Teferi's Protection, causing you to gain protection from everything and preventing your life total from changing until your next turn, and phasing all permanents you control out until your next turn, and exiling Teferi's Protection.
Repeat from step 2.

1018-1719-2628-6185.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least seven cards in hand.
You control a mana-producing permanent.
1018-1719-2628-6185.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands' cycling ability by paying {0} and discarding it due to New Perspectives.
Escape Protocol and Vizier of Tumbling Sands trigger.
Resolve the Vizier of Tumbing Sands trigger, untapping a mana-producing permanent.
Reoslve the Escape Protocol trigger, blinking Skullwinder.
When Skullwinder enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Vizier of Tumbing Sands from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the cycling ability from step 2, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

3240-4050-5075.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Nether Traitor, adding {B}.
When Nether Traitor dies, Ogre Slumlord triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature token dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2099-2793-5483.description:
During your end step, activate Sarcatog's second ability by sacrificing Ugin's Nexus.
Ugin's Nexus is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Esoteric Duplicator triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Ugin's Nexus at the beginning of your next end step.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Move to your extra turn.
At the beginning of your end step, Esoteric Duplicator triggers, creating a token copy of Ugin's Nexus.
Repeat.

586-2557-4790.description:
Activate Dino DNA by paying {6}, creating two token copies of Priest of Gix that are 6/6 Dinosaurs.
When the Priest of Gix tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, adding six {B}.
Repeat.

1533-1742-2051-2546.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two additional land cards in hand.
1533-1742-2051-2546.description:
Activate Secluded Steppe's cycling ability by paying {W} and discarding it.
 Surly Badgersaur's second ability triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Secluded Steppe ability, causing you to mill three cards and return Life from the Loam from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Skirge Familiar by discarding a land card, adding {B}.
Surly Badgersaur's second ability triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Repeat from step 4 one additional time.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {G}{W}.
Cast Life from the Loam by paying {1}{G}, returning Secluded Steppe and two other lands from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2034-2724-3049-3687-4006.notablePrerequisites:
Sophina and at least two other nontoken creatures you control do not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
2034-2724-3049-3687-4006.description:
Declare Sophina and two other nontoken creatures as attackers.
Sophina triggers, creating three Clue artifact tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wormfang Manta, adding {C}{C}.
Wormfang Manta leaves the battlefield, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
If Wormfang Manta was put onto the battlefield by Havengul Mystery, Havengul Mystery triggers, transforming itself.
Activate the Clue tokens by paying {6}, tapping and sacrificing them, causing you to draw three cards.
At the beginning of your end step, Havengul Laboratory triggers, transforming itself.
Havengul Mystery triggers, returning Wormfang Manta from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat each turn.

4241-4659-4871-5158.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
4241-4659-4871-5158.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing another creature, adding {C}{C}.
The creature dies, triggering Pitiless Plunderer, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Karn by paying {1}, causing the Treasure to become a 2/2 artifact creature until end of turn.
Repeat.
